sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Conditionals for real situations

Условные конструкции помогают говорить о разных ситуациях:

Possible

If I have time, I’ll travel.

Imaginary

If I had more money, I would travel more.

Past / regret

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

Главное: сначала понять ситуацию, потом выбрать конструкцию.

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Modal verbs in real life

Modal verbs помогают говорить о возможности, необходимости, разрешении и совете.

CAN → ability / possibility

I can drive.

COULD → polite request / possibility

Could you help me?

SHOULD → advice

You should get some rest.

MUST → strong necessity

You must show your passport.

HAVE TO → necessary because of a rule or situation

I have to work tomorrow.

sections.html:
Gerund or Infinitive?

После разных глаголов используется разная форма.

Некоторые глаголы обычно идут с -ing:

enjoy doing
avoid doing
finish doing

decide to do

sections.title: Тема
sections.html:
Modal verbs: the small differences matter

Modal verbs can express similar ideas, but the strength, certainty, politeness or attitude can change.

SHOULD → advice / expectation

You should talk to him.

MUST → strong necessity / speaker sees it as necessary

You must talk to him.

HAVE TO → necessity caused by a rule or situation

I have to attend the meeting.

CAN → ability / permission

You can leave early.

MAY → permission / possibility, often more formal

You may leave early.

COULD → possibility / softer suggestion

We could change the plan.

MIGHT → weaker possibility

We might change the plan.

Remember:

The difference is not always about right vs wrong.

Sometimes the modal changes the tone or strength of the message.
